feature: A part picked inside a title shows its row across the title only
summary: When you pick a piece inside a title (its background, its words), the row that opens for it on the timeline now starts and ends with the title, instead of running to the end of the video.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/a-part-in-a-title-rows-across-the-title-walk.json

try.do: Open the sample recording and show the timeline (Cmd 2).
Right-click track V1 and choose Add Track Above.
Right-click the new V2 and choose Add Title Page > Keynote Clean, then press Escape twice.
Double-click near the corner of the picture to pick the title's Background.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Look at the Background row under Title Page: its bar ends where the title ends, at 4s.
Drag the Title Page bar along V2 and pick the Background again: its row follows the title.

evaluate: Does the Background row now read as part of the title, rather than something on screen for the whole video?
Is the Opacity lane under it still where you expect, a short bar at the start?
Would you expect the part's row to be draggable on its own, or is picking it all a click should do?
rough: The part's row has no ends to drag, as before: it has no in or out of its own, so it only shows where the part is on screen.
Matches the timeline mock's rule that a bar runs only while its thing is on screen; no mock frame draws a title's parts opened under it.
